## Triage: graded **p1** · `domain:spec` · `area:studio` · `bug` · `pm:queue`. Handled as a protocol narrowing under the maintainer's standing rule

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-22T19:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim.

- **What it is:** `os validate` publishes two `visibleWhen` argument shapes that CEL itself refuses: a bare `has(status)` and `has(record.items[0])`. The console then faults and **fails open**. Refusing them at the page / view door narrows what an author can write.
- **Why triage routes it instead of boxing it:**
  - The maintainer's standing rule 「协议变更直接处理，排查相关的任务，和我沟通」 covers exactly this. It is handled in 18.x, with no retirement stage, and reported to the maintainer in this round's record.
  - The verdict to adopt is the `check()` judgement the flow slots already use (#25267), so no new rule is invented.
- **Changeset:** `minor`, with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (#25105) and its ADR-0087 disposition.
- **Measure first:** count the in-repo and HotCRM producers of the two shapes. A producer found means a conversion question before landing.

Ruling: needs_decision fork review (project review thread 「visibleWhen has() 失开裁决」) · letter **A** · maintainer 「对于这种类似的问题，能否你自己开一个单独的 fable thread 做评审，对于自己有把握决定的问题，自己决定，不能决定的开决策卡？」 2026-10-22T21:03Z

Proxy ruling under the maintainer's delegation quoted above, by the review thread's session `session_01TKeCN6W8bsDYTr8Ru56GY9` ([project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg49ymH47yqcW8h7xpbZJ89G)), on this card's filing, triage `6349920602`, the `os-dev-report` `6349466484` on #25267 (out-of-scope finding 1) and the contract review `6349699572` on PR #25275. Marker: `auto-adjudicated`. ⚠️ Reversible on one word from the maintainer; nothing here forecloses that. The protocol narrowing itself is handled under the maintainer's standing line 「协议变更直接处理，排查相关的任务，和我沟通」, as triage routed it, and the maintainer is told in the review thread.

## What the review thread re-verified (code read at `c9be979`, `origin/main` after PR #25275 merged as `9d96b2bc08`)

- The gap holds. `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` masks every `has(…)` call before the bare-identifier checker sees the source (`maskHasCalls`, #16118), and its one adopted `check()` verdict, `firstUnknownFunctionCall`, filters on the no-overload vocabulary. So `has(status)` and `has(record.items[0])` reach no rule: the rows at `validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts` 898–926 pin `validateVisibilityPredicates(…)` as `[]` for `has(status)` and `has(status) && has(owner)`. `celEngine.compile` and `evaluate` refuse both with `has() invalid argument` (the controls test in `cel-has-indexed-receiver.test.ts`), so the page publishes clean and the console draws the guarded element for every user (ADR-0137 D3's render direction).
- `cel-engine.ts`'s docblock above `firstUndeclaredReference` records exactly this class as ⛔ STILL OPEN, and `rewriteIndexedHas` (#25267) is deliberately narrow: it lowers only a `has()` over a `.` selection and leaves "every argument the spec itself refuses: a bare name (`has(status)`) or an index as the LAST step (`has(a[0])`)" to fault.
- The CEL language definition defines the macro as `has(e.f)` and nothing else: 「To test for the presence of a field, the boolean-valued macro `has(e.f)` can be used」, 「note that `f` must syntactically be an identifier」, and for the standard environment 「Only map accesses using the select notation are supported」. A bare name and an index are not field selections, and no binding, scope or value makes them evaluate; the reference implementation refuses them in its macro expander, before any type is known. The fault class is data-independent, in the same way function existence is.
- Producers in this repository at `c9be979`, outside tests: **0**. Every `has(<bare>)` and `has(e[i])` spelling the grep finds is TypeScript (`Map` / `Set` `.has(`), a code comment, or docs prose explaining why `has(x)` is not a null guard; no CEL string carries either shape. HotCRM is not measured here; the dispatch measures it, as triage asks.
- The #13594 boundary, read in full with its reason. The maintainer approved (「#13594 同意」) comment `5479573383`, whose scope discipline is 「只查函数存在性,不引入一般类型检查 —— 该面谓词以 `dyn` 为主的现状不动」. The execution comment `5479679994` derives from it 「只拒未知函数裁定,⛔ 不搬运 `check()` 的其他抱怨。函数存在性之外的类型盲区照旧保持盲区(`type(record.x) == string` 类合法 dyn 谓词不动)」 and states why refusal is not a false positive: 「校验/运行两环境一致 ⇒ 校验不识的函数运行时必 fault,拒之非误报」. The module note's §Function existence restates the boundary as "Existence is not type-checking" and "It cannot be a false positive … needs a fault class that is data-dependent, and existence is not one".

## Governing text

- ADR-0137 D1 (accepted 2026-09-18, maintainer 「同意」): "A predicate slot accepts only what the engine can run"; D4: "a gate predicate that is blank or faulting is **diagnosed** … A gate is a predicate, and D1's reasoning applies to it unchanged"; D3 keeps render fail-open, which is why the loud end has to be publish.
- ADR-0058 D5, row 1: "Authoring (any surface) — parse error, unknown function/var, type error → compile error — never ships".
- AGENTS.md Prime Directive #12 (reject off-spec metadata at authoring/publish, never tolerate it in a consumer) and ADR-0049 (declared ≠ enforced: enforce or remove).
- #13594 (maintainer, 2026-08-31): function existence adopted; no general type checking; `dyn` predicates untouched. Its reason that a data-independent refusal is not a false positive (identical validation and runtime environments) governs here too.
- #25267's acceptance line, carried over: "The engine and the publish validator agree."
- Ruling A on #25105: a value refused is `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `minor`, with its ADR-0087 disposition; the standing line 「协议变更直接处理，排查相关的任务，和我沟通」 with #25168 → PR #25192 as the precedent of record.

## The ruling: A — the page/view `visibleWhen` rule refuses a `has()` argument that is not a field selection, at publish, as an error

Fixed here, so the dev opens no second decision:

1. **What is refused.** On the page and view `visibleWhen` surface judged by `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` (and so `os validate`, `defineStack`, and the metadata save door through the runtime authoring gate), a `has()` call whose single argument is not a `.` field selection: a bare name (`has(status)`), an index as the last step (`has(record.items[0])`), and any other non-selection argument the engine refuses the same way. One new gating rule id in the existing family (the dev names it; `visibility-predicate-has-argument` fits), severity `error`, reported at the same site and path as its siblings, in the §Syntax discipline: the engine's verdict, plus the corrective prescription cel-js's own message lacks.
2. **What is not refused — the #13594 scope discipline stands verbatim.** `has(e.f)` for any `e`, including the indexed and call receivers #25267 lowers; every `dyn` predicate; `type == 'grid'`, `type(record.x) == string`, `upper(1, 2)`, `1 + 'a'`. ⛔ No other `check()` complaint is carried over, and the gate reads nothing about the types flowing through a predicate.
3. **Oracle = the engine, never a hand-kept list.** Two mechanisms satisfy this; the dev picks one and states it in the PR: (a) a `@objectstack/formula` helper in the shape of `firstUnknownFunctionCall` that reports cel-js's `has() invalid argument` verdict on the source after `rewriteIndexedHas`, so only spec-refused shapes remain; or (b) the canonical parse AST this rule already walks for the #16118 mask (`hasCallSpans`): a `has` call with one argument whose node is not a `.` selection, the same test `indexedHasSelection` reads. Both agree with `celEngine.compile` by construction, and the equivalence is pinned: every shape the arm refuses is refused by `compile`, and every `has()` the arm accepts compiles.
4. **The #16118 mask stays load-bearing.** The bare-identifier arm keeps excluding the `has()` argument occurrence, so a refused `has(status)` yields ONE finding with the right prescription, and `has(status) && status == 'x'` keeps its bare-identifier finding on the unwrapped occurrence beside the new one.
5. **Prescription text** names the shape the spec admits and the equivalent spellings, with no tracker number in the string: for a bare name, `has(<root>.x)` or `'x' in <root>` with the root this layer binds (`record` on runtime view and page surfaces, `data` on a metadata-editing form — the layer the rule already reads for `visibility-root-mislayered`); for an index as the last step, `size(e) > i`. No null-guard advice is repeated: `validate-null-guards` owns it (#4649 / #4763).
6. **Pins updated as part of this ruling, ⛔ not silently.** The module note's §Function existence point 2 and the "#13594 narrows this pin by exactly one axis" block in `validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts` are rewritten to two axes — function existence (#13594) and `has()` argument shape (this ruling) — both data-independent, citing this comment as the authority; the rows at 898–926 that pin `has(status)` as silent flip to the new finding; `cel-engine.ts`'s STILL OPEN bullet for `has()` records that the lint now reports it (the first-error masking fact itself is unchanged).
7. **Declarations and kit**, per ruling A on #25105 and the #25168 precedent: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `minor` on every package the diff moves, the BREAKING banner with FROM → TO and the one-line fix, exactly one ADR-0087 disposition marker. No D2 conversion: the spelling the author meant (`has(record.x)`, `'x' in record`, `record.x != null`, `size(record.items) > 0`) is not derivable and the platform does not guess (ADR-0137 D1's own reasoning). The kit is therefore a D3 semantic entry with a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector, so `os migrate meta --stored` lists a stored page or view carrying the shape under 需手动处理 (precedents: `object-external-binding-managed-datasource-refused`, PR #25192; `evaluated-expression-slots-source-required`, PR #18638), and the marker is `registered <entry id>`.
8. **Premise, measured before the first edit (回翻条款):** producers in HotCRM (`objectstack-ai/hotcrm`, shallow clone) = 0, as in this repository. A producer found is reported to the seat thread with the evidence before any edit. It does not change the direction, because the shape never evaluated anywhere, but it decides whether the release note's 需手动处理 entry names a real app.
9. ⛔ **Not:** routing page/view `visibleWhen` through `validateExpression` wholesale (option D — the general type-check widening #13594 forbids, and the `dyn` false positives it refused); inventing runtime semantics for `has(x)` or `has(e[i])` in the engine (option C — the spec refuses them; one CEL under ADR-0032); a warning tier (option E — #6253: "a warning that does not fail CI is silence with extra steps"); keeping the boundary and recording the fail-open as accepted (option B — ADR-0137 D4 already names it as the defect); any change to the render-side fail-open (ADR-0137 D3, load-bearing).

### Why A, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (weight ≥50%).** Two years out, a page predicate the engine cannot run never reaches the console: the publish gate and the runtime hold one verdict, which is #25267's acceptance line and ADR-0137 D1/D4's end state. B keeps a published hole that ADR-0137 already names as the defect; C forks the CEL dialect; D buys the type false positives #13594 refused; E is silence with extra steps.
- **② Measured business pull.** The sibling class was hit on a real page (cloud#3158's `visibleWhen`: a "no reading yet" caption drawn beside "5 MB"); the two shapes here fail the same way, for every user. Triage graded p1. In-repo producers 0, so nothing published breaks.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** `has(x)` is the shorthand this repository's own comments and docs write when they talk about the macro (`project.object.ts`, `cel-fault.ts`, `validation.mdx`), so it is the spelling a generator reproduces; `has(items[0])` is the natural guess for "is there a first item". Under A the author gets one loud publish error with the correct spellings; under B the element renders unconditionally and nothing says why.
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** One arm on an existing rule, zero new gates, no new capability, no migration path to maintain (no conversion can exist, no producer exists).

Only-① pick: A. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Effort for the chosen letter: **S–M**, one PR, `domain:spec` seat 2.

### Confidence gate (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`) as applied

- Mechanical boundary: the change pulls the publish door back to the declared contract (the CEL definition of `has(e.f)`; ADR-0137 D1) and widens nothing, which is the proxy lane.
- ① Four facets one way: above. ② Floors: no security or permission boundary moves (visibility is a non-security predicate under ADR-0058 D5); no published contract semantics move (the engine's verdict on these shapes is unchanged, the door catches up); no product capability is traded (the shapes never ran); gate strength: one error arm on an authoring rule whose refusal cannot be a false positive, the same property #13594's arm was admitted on. ③ No maintainer ruling is overturned: #13594's approved scope (function existence; no general type checking; `dyn` untouched) stands in full. The sentence 「⛔ 不搬运 `check()` 的其他抱怨」 belongs to the execution comment, and its stated object is the TYPE blind spot (「函数存在性之外的类型盲区照旧保持盲区」); a macro's argument shape is not a type verdict. This ruling is recorded as a scoped extension beside #13594, with the pins updated as part of the ruling, exactly as #13594 did to #6253. Because two seats read that sentence as reserved, the ruling is presented to the maintainer for 追认 in the review thread, and one word reverses it.
- Failure direction stays loud: a publish error, one revert.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 长远:A 让页面/视图的发布门与运行时对 `has()` 的判定一致,是 #25267 的验收句和 ADR-0137 D1/D4 已裁的终态;B 留下 ADR-0137 点名的那个洞;C 分叉 CEL 方言;D 买回 #13594 拒绝的类型误报;E 是换种说法的沉默。
② 拉动:同类形状已在真实页面上失开(cloud#3158);分诊定 p1;仓内生产者 0,不破坏任何已发布应用。
③ 防错:`has(x)` 正是本仓注释与文档谈这个宏时写的简写,生成器会照抄;A 在发布时给一条响亮错误并写出正确拼法,B 下元素无条件渲染且无人说明原因。
④ 不扩散:既有规则加一臂,零新门禁、零新能力、无迁移路径(无转换可表达、无生产者),工作量 S–M。
Prior rulings read: #13594 `5479573383`(维护者「#13594 同意」)、`5479679994`(执行精化 1–6);#6253(语法 error 级);#16118 → PR #16413(掩码按出现位置);#25267 → PR #25275 契约复审 `6349699572`;#25105 ruling A;#25168 分诊 `6333828054`(协议收窄常设句);ADR-0137 D1/D3/D4、ADR-0058 D5、ADR-0049、ADR-0032、ADR-0087;thread: `6349920602`、`6349466484`。

## Execution after the ruling

- The card already carries `pm:queue` (triage `6349920602`); no label moves. The `domain:spec` seat records this ruling on the card (body first line `Ruled: <this comment id> · letter A · <UTC>`) and dispatches from the queue with `Ruling-ref: <this comment id>` when it holds a slot. ⛔ Ruling is not dispatching.
- File surface: `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts` and its tests; `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` (the STILL OPEN docblock, and the helper if mechanism (a) is taken) and its tests; the ADR-0087 kit under `packages/spec/src/conversions/**` and `packages/spec/src/migrations/**` with the generated references; one changeset. Stop on breach.
- Review: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue (narrowing face), effort `xhigh` (p1), run by the seat; the dogfood battery per the `(narrowing)` arm rule. The PR stays draft until the maintainer's 追认 reaches the review thread or the card.
- Not reopened: #13594's function-existence arm and its no-suggestion refinement; the #16118 mask; `rewriteIndexedHas`; `validate-null-guards` (#4649 / #4763); the console's render fail-open (ADR-0137 D3); #25282 (the `guardOf` docblock) stays its own S card.
